description: This PHP file defines a function `additionalDetailsProject` that generates supplementary details (like description snippets with links) for a Project entity within the SuiteCRM platform. It makes use of language localization and constructs HTML content for display in the UI.
external_files: possibly external SuiteCRM core files that define $current_language and return_module_language

methods.name: additionalDetailsProject
methods.description: Generates a string containing project description preview and links, used to display additional project info in the SuiteCRM UI.
